test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The sergeant ordered the soldiers to be __armed to the teeth__ as he expected it to be a tough fight.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"armed to the teeth"** means to be fully equipped or prepared for a difficult situation. (पूरी तरह से सुसज्जित या तैयार होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The security team was armed to the teeth to handle any threat during the event.
 
 
 
• **"Well-equipped or prepared" **refers to having all the necessary tools, resources, or information to handle a task or situation effectively. (अच्छी तरह से सुसज्जित या तैयार)
 
 
• **Example: **The students were well-equipped for their exams with all the required study materials and notes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the idiom **'armed to the teeth' **means **'well-equipped or prepared'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Separated from the worthless **(अमूल्य से अलग): To distinguish or segregate valuable things from those that are worthless.

 
 
• **Example:** The expert was able to separate the valuable artifacts from the worthless imitations.
 
 
 
• **Active without any goals **(कोई लक्ष्य न होने पर सक्रिय): Engaging in activities without any specific purpose or objectives.
 
 
• **Example: **He was active without any goals, participating in various clubs but never committing to any.
 
 
 
• **Working in a great hurry** (बहुत जल्दी में काम करना): Performing tasks quickly, often with a sense of urgency and sometimes carelessly.
 
 
• **Example:** She was working in a great hurry to meet the project deadline.
 
 

140:Tc11,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
